subject.title: feat(skills): declarative cron-trigger metadata in SKILL.md frontmatter

question: Should installed SKILL.md metadata be allowed to register scheduled or event-driven future agent runs, and if so which permissioned contract owns that behavior?
rationale: This choice defines a public skill metadata/API surface and autonomous execution trust boundary; code inspection shows no existing implementation or settled owner boundary to preserve.

options.title: Design permissioned trigger contract
options.body: Keep the issue open and define approval, provenance, revocation, event semantics, state ownership, and whether the field belongs in SKILL.md metadata, ClawHub metadata, explicit cron jobs, or plugin APIs before implementation.

options.title: Route scheduling to explicit cron/plugins
options.body: Reject autonomous SKILL.md registration for now and document explicit cron jobs or plugin hooks as the supported automation path.

options.title: Allow documentation-only metadata
options.body: Accept a non-executing trigger_description field for audits while deferring functional scheduler registration until the trust model is settled.

recommendation.title: Design permissioned trigger contract
recommendation.body: Keep the issue open and define approval, provenance, revocation, event semantics, state ownership, and whether the field belongs in SKILL.md metadata, ClawHub metadata, explicit cron jobs, or plugin APIs before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision crosses current skill loading and cron scheduling surfaces where Vincent has recent history and release ownership signals.
